title: ChainedTogether
description: This is a chained together plugin
body:
# ⛓️ Chained Together

**A co-op Minecraft challenge inspired by Chained Together.**

You and another player are connected by a magical chain. Stay close, work together, and defeat Minecraft's strongest bosses to earn your freedom.

## Objective

Defeat all three guardians:

* 🐉 Ender Dragon
* 💀 Wither
* 👁 Warden

Once all three are defeated, the chain breaks and the challenge is complete.

## Features

* Animated chain connecting players
* Distance limit and pull-back mechanics
* Boss objective system
* Cinematic boss completion events
* Narrator dialogue from **The Chain**
* Victory cutscene and fireworks
* Custom Releaser item

## The Releaser

A legendary relic capable of weakening the chain.

### Crafting Recipe

🟦 = Diamond Block

| 🟦 | ⬛  | 🟦 |
| -- | -- | -- |
| ⬛  | 🟦 | ⬛  |
| ⬛  | ⬛  | ⬛  |

### Ability

* Right-click to consume
* Permanently increases chain length by **+1 block**
* Can be used multiple times throughout a run

> *"Freedom is not given. It is earned, one link at a time."*

## Commands

### /chain start

Starts a new Chained Together run.

* Chains two players together
* Resets all boss objectives
* Begins the challenge

## Victory

Complete all objectives:

* Ender Dragon ✅
* Wither ✅
* Warden ✅

After defeating all three, a final cinematic plays, the chain breaks, and your team is free.

## Challenge

Work together.

Stay together.

Break the chain. ⛓️🔥
